fusions.name: Ram Break
fusions.desc: A headbutt that deals 16 damage, stuns the target for 1.2 seconds and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Hardhead Jab
fusions.desc: A short thrust that deals 5 damage, rising to 1.2 times that at its full reach of 2 tiles. Its damage rises 8% for every 10% of your own health already lost (max 40%).

fusions.name: Cliffside Stance
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 25% and your physical resistance by 12% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Stand Fast
fusions.desc: Once every 240 seconds, a blow that would kill you leaves you at 1 health instead.
